question: Related Questions Q. I'm an umarried girl and I've been wanting to get married for a long time. Today, I had a dream in which I was getting married ( I don't remember who to ),and a lot of people were coming and congratulating me and i was feeling extremely shy. I've heard seeing oneself getting married in a dream is not a good sign...please interpret my dream for me. i'm very worried. 1642 views Q. I have a question regarding a dream I had. First I need to give you a background of the situation. I married a few months back and with the grace of Allah, my husband and I are trying to have a child. During last week, my mother has had dreams every night about babies and flowers and eating fruits and sweets. She tells me she thinks it is because I may be pregnant. Before I went to sleep one night after my mother told me this, I made dua to Allah to show me a sign in a dream whether I am pregnant or not and then I went to sleep. During that night, I had a dream that a lady doctor has come to my house and she is telling me that she can detect two pulse readings in my body, and she is telling me it is good news (that I am pregnant), in the dream I feel happy, and then I woke up. Please tell me what the meaning of this dream is, and if this relates to the dreams my mother is having almost every night about babies and me being pregnant. JazakAllah Khair. 1636 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 7003 Country: India Title: I would like to ask that do all dreams have meanings? i often see things in my dream that i saw the day before. could this have a meaning? do ALL dreams have meanings? Question: I would like to ask that do all dreams have meanings? i often see things in my dream that i saw the day before. could this have a meaning? do ALL dreams have meanings? jazakallah Answer ID: 7003 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1786/1385=H/1429) The human mind is the store of different thoughts. Sometimes, the forms seen in the day are manifested with these thoughts which are transferred by the Imagination Power the soul. This causes those scenes to appear in the dreams. Such dreams need no interpretation. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
